usageNotes: Use this endpoint to re-arm the Proxmox HA stack after it has been intentionally disarmed (e.g., following a manual quorum override or maintenance window). The call takes no parameters, returns null synchronously, and requires the Sys.Console privilege on the root path. Verify HA status via get_cluster_ha_status after calling to confirm the manager has resumed normal operation.

examples.summary: Re-arm the HA stack after a maintenance window

tips: The HA manager will only honor the re-arm once cluster quorum is restored; if the cluster is still partitioned or lacks quorum the manager will remain disarmed.
After calling this endpoint, poll GET /cluster/ha/status to confirm the HA manager state transitions back to 'master' or 'slave' (not 'error' or 'stopped').
This endpoint is idempotent — calling it when the HA stack is already armed has no effect and does not return an error.
